detail.title: WAKE Research Update: Intelligent Disobedience Modeling
detail.summary: This update revises the synthesis of intelligent disobedience strategies by incorporating evidence on physical environment adaptability, specifically integrating the Open Ant framework alongside existing shared autonomy research.

detail.title: Formalizing Intelligent Disobedience via Shared Autonomy and Heuristic Search
detail.summary: This synthesis evaluates how intelligent agents can be mathematically modeled to perform 'intelligent disobedience' in safety-critical shared autonomy, now incorporating physical environmental constraints.
detail.reason: Incorporating physical environment evidence (Open Ant) into the existing synthesis to better model environmental adaptation in shared autonomy.
